notes:
• A fresh, clean build of Taka with everything from 0.3.6: account details for banks, wallets and Rapid Pass, the daily limit day by day, and the accounting fixes.

• Your data stays as it is. Updating from any earlier version keeps every account, entry, budget, loan and savings plan, and nothing is moved or changed.

• The screenshots and cover use made-up sample data. No real person's money data is part of the app or its download page.

Already on an older version? Open Settings, then App updates, to install this one. Your data stays. A backup made on 0.3.6 or later cannot be restored on an older version.
